cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Hole cleaning is an important part of all installations and has an essential effect on the performance of the anchorages.
The drill hole must be cleaned, starting from the bottom of the drill hole.
Fully extend the pump piston. Insert the flexible tube to the bottom of the drill hole. Push the piston back rapidly to blow out the dust from the drill hole. Repeat this procedure.
A combination of correct diameter brush and compressed air (compressor or Sika AnchorFix® Cleaning Pump) must be used to clean the drill holes.
Do not use other cleaning pump types. Sika AnchorFix® Cleaning Pump is designed to produce the correct volume of air for the different size drill holes.
